partnerProfile.title: Partner Profile Setup
partnerProfile.intro: This is a one-time activity. The details you enter here will be used to calculate your CSP incentives and map the available MCI engagements by solution and eligibility.
partnerProfile.partnerTypeQuestion: Are you a CSP Direct or a CSP Indirect partner?
partnerProfile.partnerTypeNote: Direct and Indirect CSP partners qualify for different incentive percentages from Microsoft. We'll apply the right rates to every proposal automatically.
partnerProfile.directFollowUp: Do you hold a Modern Work or Security Solutions Partner designation?
partnerProfile.indirectFollowUp: Do you have more than 25 partner capability points in the Modern Work or Security solution area?
partnerProfile.revenueNote: The Partner should also have $25K revenue in trailing 12 months to qualify for CSP incentives.
partnerProfile.designationsQuestion: Which of the following Solutions Partner designations do you currently hold? (Select all that apply)
partnerProfile.specializationsQuestion: Which of the following specializations do you currently hold? (Select all that apply)
partnerProfile.specializationsNoDesignationsHint: Select at least one Solutions Partner designation above to see its specializations.
partnerProfile.jumpstartQuestion: Are you enrolled in Copilot JumpStart at Ready tier or higher?
partnerProfile.logoConstraints: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG, up to 2MB.
partnerProfile.logoError: Logo upload failed. Please try again.
partnerProfile.marginLabel: What margin do you typically apply on the ERP?
partnerProfile.marginNote: Used as the default margin in every proposal's pricing. You can update it here anytime.
partnerProfile.summaryNote: Amounts shown are the tier A (e.g. US) USD figures; the exact incentive varies by customer market.
partnerProfile.summaryGateFailed: Based on your answers, you don't currently qualify for MCI engagement incentives. You can still create proposals; update your profile when your designations or capability points change.
